thought.text: Let me verify WebSocket proxy is working:

reasoning_content:
The server doesn't show WebSocket connections. This means either:
1. Client is not connecting via WebSocket
2. WebSocket is failing before reaching the server

Let me check if nginx is proxying WebSocket correctly by testing manually:

action.command:
curl -v -k \
  -H "Host: arelorian.de" \
  -H "Connection: Upgrade" \
  -H "Upgrade: websocket" \
  -H "Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13" \
  -H "Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSB3b3JsZA==" \
  https://arelorian.de/ws 2>&1 | grep -E "HTTP|101|101 Switching"
